sections.heading: Overview
sections.intent: Define the topic, say who it is for and state what the reader will be able to decide after reading the hub

sections.heading: Key Areas
sections.intent: Introduce every child topic in its own short paragraph that links to the child page with a descriptive anchor

sections.heading: How to Choose
sections.intent: Give the decision criteria a reader should weigh before going deeper into one child topic

sections.heading: Common Questions
sections.intent: Answer the five questions people ask most about the topic, one short paragraph each, phrased as the reader would search

sections.heading: Related Topics
sections.intent: Point to approved sibling topics with one sentence each explaining the connection

spec.tone: Authoritative and plain; second person; short paragraphs; no superlatives, no marketing claims, no filler transitions
